host.description: Hostname or IP of the MySQL server to connect to.

port.description: Port number to use for the MySQL connection.

socket.description: Path to the MySQL unix socket file.

use_tcp.description: Force TCP connection instead of socket connection.

mysqladmin_path.description: Absolute path to the mysqladmin binary.

mysqlcmd_path.description: Absolute path to the mysql binary.

skip_size.description: Do not enumerate tables and their types/sizes (recommended for many tables).

output_json.description: Print the result as a JSON string.

skip_password_checks.description: Skip checks on user account passwords.

forced_mem.description: Force the amount of RAM installed in megabytes (0 to use auto-detect).

forced_swap.description: Force the amount of swap memory configured in megabytes (0 to use auto-detect).

output_file.description: Path to a file where the output report will be written.

silent.description: Do not output anything on the screen (useful for logging to output_file only).

verbose.description: Print out all options including detailed statistics.

nondedicated.description: Consider the server is not dedicated to DB server usage only.
